title: Inference Request Path
creator: Dan McCreary
subject: DGX Evaluation for Textbook Generation
description: Open the six stages of a chat completion request, then find the stage responsible for each of four described events.

educational.topic: Inference Servers and Local API Endpoints
learningObjectives: The learner will explain what each of 6 stages of a chat completion request does by opening each stage and then locating the stage responsible for each of 4 described events, with at least 3 of 4 correct.

pedagogical.teachingStrategy: Commit an answer, then see the correct answer and the reason
keyQuestions: A request returns "model not found" in a few milliseconds. Explain why the speed of that failure is itself evidence about the stage.
commonMisconceptions: The first request is slow because the GPU is slow.
A wrong model name is rejected by the model.
A refused connection is a model problem.
Token counts are computed by the client.
assessmentOpportunities: Mastery is 3 of 4 correct on the first attempt.

chapter_title: Inference Servers and Local API Endpoints
